title: Producing quickly to avoid overtime
summary: Producers hired McRae because he finished dates without costly overtime.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: A lot of engineers -- lot of producer -- you know, when you produce, they work different than I would do.
I work different probably than they work the different way, you know. But he liked the way I put things together.
Because I put them together quick, you know. It's not a whole lot of overtime, see.
Back in them days, they hire you because if you can do a date and do a date without running into two or three hours overtime.
A lot of guys go in to do a date and they go in there with a twenty piece band, they run into two or three -- they run overtime. They didn't like all that.
(Inaudible) man spend so much money for a date. And you got two or three hours overtime, you gonna run in maybe six or seven hundred dollars in overtime.
